explanation: A silicon microring resonance shifts about 69 pm per kelvin, which is why every ring needs active thermal stabilization (~1 mW). 0.69 pm/K and 6.9 nm/K are off by two orders of magnitude in opposite directions; 1.87 pm/K mistakes the thermo-optic coefficient's mantissa for the drift rate.
